Evelyn (Support): Meridian Labs onboarding blocked — provision API returns 403 during key creation. Demo scheduled tomorrow AM, customer is waiting.
Diego (CSM): Renewal in 11 days. This is high priority. We need a quick comms + mitigation plan.
Evelyn (Support): Ticket #69421. Log excerpt:
```
2026-03-25T09:22:17Z ERROR provision failed status=403 body="error: token_missing_tenant_claim"
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/provision -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_z12' -d '{"tenant":"meridian-labs"}'
```
Priya (CS Ops): Suggested comms: 1) immediate acknowledgement to Meridian w/ ETA 2-3h (Evelyn), 2) infra to generate a tenant-scoped short-lived token if needed (Rex), 3) CS to propose a backup demo window and offer hosted trial keys if we can't fix within 4h (Diego).
Diego (CSM): Send the ack and block the 11am demo slot tentatively. Also loop in account exec.
Evelyn (Support): Ack sent. Meridian replied: "Please escalate — we advertised this demo to leadership." :exclamation:
Rex (Infra): On it. Initial check: token validator started rejecting tokens without `tid` claim after recent policy tighten. I can either relax validator or issue a strictly-scoped temp token limited to provision:onboard for a single tenant. Recommend temp token + audit.
Priya (CS Ops): CS approves temp token approach with the following constraints: TTL <= 6h, single-tenant scope, audit entry, rotate immediately after onboarding.
NotifyBot: Temp token request recorded (#temp-req-1003). Audit trail created.
Rex (Infra): Generated temp token (TTL 4h) scoped to ["provision:onboard"] for meridian-labs. Delivered via secure channel and recorded in audit.
Evelyn (Support): Delivered token to Meridian securely. They confirmed keys visible and completed initial import. Demo confirmed for 2pm fallback window. :white_check_mark:
Diego (CSM): Following up with account exec to document mitigation and adjust renewal note. Also capturing enablement feedback from Meridian after demo.
Priya (CS Ops): Action items assigned:
- Evelyn: add ticket + secure convo to CS handoff doc (owner Evelyn)
- Rex: file INF-1182 to either update token issuer to include tenant claim or provide tooling for per-tenant provisioning (owner Rex)
- Diego: notify account exec and record renewal impact (owner Diego)
- Priya: update onboarding checklist to include a provisioning smoke test and pre-kickoff auth validation (owner Priya)
Evelyn (Support): Handoff doc added: https://docs.redwood.ai/handoffs/69421 (logs + ack)
Rex (Infra): INF-1182 filed. Will include rollout plan and a safe migration path.
Diego (CSM): I'll run post-demo enablement and capture any docs gaps. If Meridian requests a make-good, we'll handle via account exec.
Priya (CS Ops): Closing loop for now. Keeping INF-1182 open and adding a runbook entry for temporary tenant tokens. Thanks team. :handshake:
